text:
release-bot: [deploybot] CANARY-PAUSE: post-upgrade hook job `db-migrate` failed during canary for chart=redwood-inference-api v2.4.0 in us-east-1 (canary=5%). Hook retries exhausted. Abort canary.

sam: ugh. which hook failed and why? logs?

release-bot: hook_log: job/db-migrate returned 1. Error: permission denied creating rolebinding for serviceaccount `redwood-migrations`. ClusterRoleBinding: forbidden.

rachel: that sounds like the chart added a cluster-scoped migration job without required RBAC grant in the namespace. This is unsafe to auto-promote.

finn: two immediate options: (A) rollback chart to v2.3.9 (previous stable) clusterwide and resume, or (B) perform image-only promote but disable migration job via values override for the canary. Option B keeps the chart version pinned and avoids cluster-scoped RBAC changes.

priya: prefer B for speed. We can't grant cluster perms mid-deploy without org approval. How to disable migration? is there a flag?

rachel: chart has values.migration.enabled (defaults true). We can do helm upgrade with --set migration.enabled=false --reuse-values and set image.tag to hotfix. That avoids running the post-upgrade job. But we must pin the chart in releasebot so the release automation doesn't later flip the flag back.

finn: agree. plan: (1) pin chart v2.3.9 in releasebot for us-east namespaces to block automated rollforward, (2) perform image-only helm upgrade with migration.enabled=false for canary, (3) monitor health for 15m gates then promote. Post-promote, open PR to add proper ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding with change window and security review.

sam: tagging: @priya please pin releasebot, @finn do the helm image-only with values override, @rachel start the RBAC PR and loop in sec. I'll monitor.

priya: pin set: releasebot pinned chart=2.3.9 for us-east with reason `quarantine-postupgrade-hook-rbac`. auto-promote disabled. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: action logged: releasebot pin by priya at 2026-03-21T14:12:03Z.

finn: dry-run command:```bash
helm upgrade redwood-inference-api ./chart --namespace prod-us-east \
  --reuse-values \
  --set image.tag=v2.4.0-hotfix-no-migrate \
  --set migration.enabled=false \
  --atomic --timeout 5m --dry-run
```
Dry-run looks good. Will execute live in 30s.

release-bot: note: because chart version is pinned, the deploy pipeline will ignore new chart metadata for this namespace until manual-unpin.

finn: live upgrade to canary 5% done. health: pod restarts stable, migration job not created. 502s stayed at baseline. dashboard: https://observability.internal/redwood/releases/3840001234

sam: good. start 25% gate in 10m if stable. remember to watch job controller for any stray migration job creations.

rachel: opening PR: "chart(v2.4.1): migrate RBAC for db-migrate job to optional clusterrole + documentation; add opt-in flag `migration.clusterRole=true`". tagging @security and platform-ops for review. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/charts/pull/412

priya: after 15m stable I'll approve promote to 25% and then 100%. keep pin until RBAC PR merges and security signs off, or 24h whichever is longer.

finn: acknowledged. promotion schedule: 5% -> 25% (manual) -> 100% (manual) with 15m health gates.

sam: release notes snippet (draft): "Hotfix: bypass db migration job in canary for v2.4.0 due to missing cluster RBAC. Image-only promotion with migration.disabled. Full chart rollout deferred until RBAC review and opt-in flag added." I'll post to #release-notes after final image tag.

priya: pin comment updated: `pin-expires: when-rbac-reviewed-or-24h`

ops-bot: scheduled manual promote at 2026-03-21T14:40:00Z pending human approval.

sam: everyone ack to proceed with manual promotes once 5% gate holds 15m.

finn: ack.

rachel: ack — I'll follow PR and ping sec.

priya: ack.

release-bot: thread closed for auto-actions. Manual approvals required to continue.
